outcomes.summary: Reported H13 is bent at room temperature and 50 C, H12 changes from straight to bent, H23 from bent to straight. This is passive material behavior.
B1 hot/cold fixity and recovery are high in the reported specimen tests; these are literature observations, not pass thresholds for a new specimen.
Illuminated LED in depicted configurations supports qualitative continuity, not constant quantitative conductivity.
Large folds and strain-dependent angle are reported with five-result error bars in the angle series.
Predicted stress/strain fields and shape comparisons cannot be relabeled measured sensor data.
